university.name: Royal Holloway, University of London
university.summary: Royal Holloway, University of London has its main campus at Egham Hill, Egham, Surrey. Its website describes the campus as 40 minutes by train from central London and seven miles from Heathrow Airport.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.duration_text: 3 years full-time (MSci, year in industry and integrated foundation year variants also listed)
courses.overview: Three-year full-time BSc at the Egham campus. Year 1 modules are all core and cover programming, mathematics and software design; later years add team and individual projects with optional specialist modules.
courses.academic_requirements: A level AAB to ABB including Computer Science, Mathematics or Physics, with GCSE Mathematics grade 6 and English Language grade 4. IB: HL 665 without Diploma or 34 overall with Diploma.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, no subscore lower than 5.5. PTE 67 overall, no subscore lower than 59. TOEFL iBT 88 overall with Reading 18, Listening 17, Speaking 20, Writing 17. Duolingo 120 overall, no subscore lower than 100. Trinity ISE III.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistani HSC applicants need to take the one year International Foundation Year or International Year One programme (or an equivalent from another institution) before starting a degree. A level or IB applicants may be considered for direct entry. No percentage or CGPA is stated for undergraduate entry.
courses.notes: Course page gives the fee for 2027/28 but no start month, so intake_labels is empty. Pakistan percentage not stated by the university for undergraduate entry.

courses.title: Business and Management
courses.duration_text: 3 years full-time (year in business and accelerated 2-year variants also listed)
courses.overview: Three-year full-time BSc at the Egham campus. Year 1 modules are all compulsory and cover accounting, marketing, organisations and digital enterprise; year 3 includes impact projects and management consulting.
highlights: Fundamentals of Accounting and Finance (year 1, compulsory)
Business and Management Impact Project I (year 3, compulsory)
courses.academic_requirements: A level ABB to BBB with GCSE English Language and Mathematics grade 4. IB: HL 655 without Diploma or 32 overall with Diploma.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall with 6.0 in Writing and a minimum of 5.5 in each subscore. PTE 67 overall, 63 in Writing, no other subscore below 59. TOEFL iBT 88 overall with Reading 18, Listening 17, Speaking 20, Writing 19. Duolingo 120 overall, 115 Literacy, 115 Production, no subscore below 100. Trinity ISE IV.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistani HSC applicants need to take the one year International Foundation Year or International Year One programme (or an equivalent from another institution) before starting a degree. A level or IB applicants may be considered for direct entry. No percentage or CGPA is stated for undergraduate entry.
courses.notes: Course page gives the fee for 2027/28 but no start month, so intake_labels is empty. min_ielts_band 5.5 is the general subscore minimum; Writing needs 6.0. Pakistan percentage not stated by the university for undergraduate entry.

courses.title: Finance
courses.duration_text: 1 year full-time; part-time over 2 years also offered
courses.overview: One-year full-time master's in finance for graduates in economics, mathematics or other maths-based disciplines. Core modules cover finance theory, quantitative methods and econometrics, with a dissertation and optional modules.
highlights: Investment and Portfolio Management (optional, sample for the current year)
courses.academic_requirements: UK 2:2 bachelor's honours degree or equivalent in Economics, Mathematics or other maths-based disciplines.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, no subscore lower than 6.0. PTE 67 overall, no other subscore lower than 64. TOEFL iBT 88 overall with Reading 22, Listening 20, Speaking 22, Writing 24. Duolingo 120 overall, no subscore lower than 115. Trinity ISE III; Cambridge Advanced grade C.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: A 4-year bachelor's degree (or combined 4-year bachelor's and master's) may be considered; most departments ask for a GPA of between 2.8/4.0 and 3.5/4.0, or a final grade of between 58% and 68%. The range is general, not specific to this course.
courses.application_deadline_note: Page gives 2027 deadlines, for example apply by 27 June 2027 for a decision by 16 July.
courses.notes: Course page gives the fee for 2027/28 but no start month, so intake_labels is empty. Pakistan grade range is general across departments, so pk_min fields are null.

courses.title: Applied Data Science
courses.duration_text: 1 year full-time; part-time over 2 years also offered
courses.overview: One-year full-time master's for graduates in a STEM subject with quantitative skills. Core modules cover computing for data analysis, data processing, visualisation and ethics, followed by an individual project.
highlights: Methods of Visualisation and Exploratory Analysis (core)
Individual Project in Applied Data Science (core)
courses.academic_requirements: UK 2:2 bachelor's honours degree or equivalent in a STEM subject, plus quantitative skills training or an A level (or equivalent) in Mathematics.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, no subscore lower than 5.5. PTE 67 overall, no subscore lower than 59. TOEFL iBT 88 overall with Reading 18, Listening 17, Speaking 20, Writing 17. Duolingo 120 overall, no subscore lower than 100. Trinity ISE III.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: A 4-year bachelor's degree (or combined 4-year bachelor's and master's) may be considered; most departments ask for a GPA of between 2.8/4.0 and 3.5/4.0, or a final grade of between 58% and 68%. The range is general, not specific to this course.
courses.application_deadline_note: Page gives 2027 deadlines, for example apply by 27 June 2027 for a decision by 16 July.
courses.notes: Course page gives the fee for 2027/28 but no start month, so intake_labels is empty. Page says six taught modules plus a project but lists seven taught core modules plus the project. Pakistan grade range is general across departments, so pk_min fields are null.

scholarships.name: Royal Holloway Pakistan Masters Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 6,000 tuition fee reduction in the first year of study
scholarships.summary: Tuition reduction for self-funded international-fee masters students currently living in Pakistan who hold an offer for a full-time masters. Eligibility depends on place of residence, not nationality. Awarded automatically.
scholarships.criteria_text: International fee status; currently living in Pakistan; offer for a full-time masters; self-funded. Cannot be combined with another Royal Holloway tuition scholarship or discount; the highest value applies.
scholarships.notes: Page covers offers for September 2026, January 2027 or September 2027 and says updated terms for 2027 entry will be published soon.

scholarships.name: Royal Holloway International Undergraduate Scholarship 2027
scholarships.value_text: GBP 3,000 tuition fee reduction for each year of study
scholarships.summary: Annual tuition reduction for international undergraduates with BBB at A level, IB 30 overall or 5,5,5 at Higher Level, or equivalent grades, holding an offer for September 2027. Awarded automatically.
scholarships.criteria_text: International fee status; A level BBB, IB 30 overall or 5,5,5 in Higher Levels, or equivalent; offer for an undergraduate degree starting September 2027.
scholarships.notes: Full terms linked on the page are for 2026 entry and will be updated for 2027 entry. No Pakistan-specific grade equivalence stated.
